Therefore, it can be said that each non-bottom layer of CAS-LSTM accepts two sets of hidden and cell states—one from the left context and the other from the below context. The left and the below context participate in computation with the equivalent procedure so that the information from lower layers can be efficiently propagated. Fig. FIGREF1 compares CAS-LSTM to the conventional stacked LSTM architecture, and Fig. FIGREF8 depicts the computation flow of the CAS-LSTM.
